TranslationNote: Additional language packs are previews and have not been independently reviewed. Untranslated technical details use English.
IdentitySimpleNote: Leave blank to check your own access. To check someone else, enter their Windows account. If the required information cannot be confirmed, the result will be unknown.
AccessExplanation: Granted: the rules allow this action. Denied: the rules do not allow it. Unknown: there is not enough information for a reliable conclusion. Other Windows restrictions can still prevent opening the item.
SimpleExplanation: Discover what someone can do in a folder and which rules explain that access. Analysis does not change files or permissions.
ErrorAccess: Windows did not authorize this operation. Check that your account can access the selected location.
ErrorFile: The file or folder could not be accessed. Check that the location is available and try again.
ErrorWindows: A Windows component did not respond as expected. Try again. Technical details were recorded on this computer.
ConfirmPath: Type the exact file path to confirm
ChangeWarning: This changes the file’s real permissions. A snapshot and rollback record will be saved first. Windows will verify the descriptor after writing. This workflow supports local files only.
HomeTitle:
What do you want
to understand?
HomeIntro: See who appears in a folder’s permissions. Follow the evidence to understand why.
ReadOnlyNote: PermissionScope reads existing permissions. Analysis and simulation do not change them.
IdentityNote: Leave empty to use your current Windows token. Other identities need Windows S4U; incomplete contexts are marked Unknown.
AnalyzeIntro: Start with a path. Permissions are read directly from Windows.
EmptyDetail: Analyze a folder to see permissions and their evidence.
Filter: Filter by path, identity or SID
NoSelection: Select an object to inspect its access.
PrincipalsNote: These entries are not a complete list of people. Effective rights below apply to the selected identity.
NoFindings: No rules triggered for this object.
NoEvidence: No ordinary ACE contributes. Review owner rights, NULL DACL or the stated limitations.
TechnicalScope: Calculated by Windows Authz. Discretionary access only; file-open success, integrity policies, privileges, encryption and locks are outside this decision.
MembershipCaution: Token membership proves inclusion, not a direct parent-child relationship.
SimulationNote: Remove an ACE in memory and recalculate for the selected identity. No permissions are written. Descendant propagation is not simulated.
Author: Created by Samuel Sanches
AboutText: Native Windows permission analysis. No accounts, telemetry, subscriptions or cloud services.
ErrorTitle: The operation could not be completed
SnapshotIntro: Local observations, preserved with their evidence and integrity checks.
CompareIntro: Compare two observations. An object missing from a later scan is not assumed to be deleted.
NoChanges: No descriptor changes found in the shared scope.
InheritedSourceNote: The inherited flag is recorded by Windows. The originating ancestor has not been proven.
ScheduleIntro: Create a daily Windows Task Scheduler task using your current account. It runs only while you are signed in. Snapshots remain local.
ReportPrint: The HTML report supports printing to PDF from your browser.
DemoNote: Fictional LAB identities and permissions, evaluated by Windows Authz. No accounts or permissions are changed.
KnownDescriptor: The permission rules were read; their evidence is shown below.
UnknownRead: Windows could not read this resource.
UnknownConditional: These rules require additional claims or object context.
UnknownLink: Access to the link target was not verified.
UnknownRemote: The server logon and its groups were not verified.
UnknownContext: The selected identity's actual logon context was not verified.
UnknownMeaning: Unknown does not mean allowed or denied.
UnknownNext: Check the stated limitation with the resource administrator before relying on this result.
ScopeCaution: This evaluates permission rules. Other Windows restrictions may still prevent access.
EvidenceIntro: Follow the selected identity through the recorded membership and permission evidence.
